checks.name: precondition: no site-default rate policy exists
a session on a policy-less lane IS queued for the cloud
…and its payload omits site_id rather than blocking on it
…and carries the plate the cloud correlates by
a brand-new session needs pushing
…and appears in the push list
markSyncOk stamps cloud_synced_at on the session
…clears any previous error
…and it no longer needs pushing
…and the queue row is gone
recording the exit makes the session need pushing again
…while KEEPING the previous acknowledgement (stale, not absent)
the exit push carries free_reason
…and the exit fields the cloud page renders
markSyncFailed records the reason on the session
…and does NOT clear the earlier acknowledgement
a transaction push is queued
…and does NOT mark its session as delivered
three identical pushes queue ONE row
an edit bumps the session rev
…and the changed version queues a SECOND row
a cloud-restored session is listed as not-yet-acknowledged (known trade-off)
